method: Actual Range/Duel simulations plus unmodified engine repeatZoom/Range secondary methods. Minimal host supplies settings, held-bind reads and a no-op audio sink; no renderer construction. Synthetic120Hz frame callbacks, production untilEvent boundaries and exact input edges. Duel repeatZoom queues an edge for the next simulation call, as its engine does. Atomic both-button fixtures are Duel-only; ordered Range DOM-equivalent edges are not called an atomic native command. No native execution or physical input timing.
